data.reason: The cable modem dropped out of service around 02:01 (No Ranging Response - T3 time-out, then TFTP config file NOT FOUND), causing the internet outage; it only completed re-registration around 02:28, and the firewall's WAN has not been refreshed since because the watchdog runs in observe mode.

data.cause: The cable modem dropped out of service around 02:01 (No Ranging Response - T3 time-out, then TFTP config file NOT FOUND), causing the internet outage; it only completed re-registration around 02:28, and the firewall's WAN has not been refreshed since because the watchdog runs in observe mode.
evidence: Modem log shows the trigger: 'No Ranging Response received - T3 time-out' at 02:01:44 and 'TFTP failed - configuration file NOT FOUND' at 02:14:10, then 'Cable Modem Reboot ... registration complete' at 02:28:21 (cat /var/db/wan-watchdog/modem-events.jsonl)
Watchdog metrics show modem state NOT_SYNCHRONIZED at 02:06, becoming OPERATIONAL only by 02:29-02:40 (cat /var/db/wan-watchdog/modem-metrics.jsonl)

Watchdog events: decisions 'none' while modem not_operational/settling, then action 'reload' decided at 02:30 and retry at 02:40, all logged as 'would_reload' with mode=observe, i.e. no actual reload happened (tail /var/db/wan-watchdog/events.jsonl, cat state.json: last_action reload, reloads_in_outage 2)

Firewall WAN itself is healthy: vtnet0 UP/RUNNING/LOWER_UP with leased address 198.51.100.27, valid lease to 2026/3/6, default route via 198.51.100.1, gateway ARP-resolved (ifconfig vtnet0; netstat -rn; arp -n; cat /var/db/dhclient.leases.vtnet0)
Yet traffic through the modem fails: ping to gateway 198.51.100.1 = 100% packet loss despite L2 reachability (ping -c 3 -n 198.51.100.1)
data.recommendation: Now that the modem has re-registered and reports OPERATIONAL, reconfigure/renew the firewall's WAN interface so it picks up a fresh session from the provider. The outage was caused by the modem losing sync and its config file (TFTP NOT FOUND) at ~02:01; if this recurs repeatedly with T3 timeouts / TFTP failures, escalate to the ISP since the root trigger is on their plant/CPE side.
data.detail: Cable modem lost ISP sync/re-registration at ~02:01
